+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Archive all .txt reports from /workspace/reports into a dated zip file.
+
+- Output archive: /workspace/archives/reports_<YYYY-MM-DD>.zip
+- Overwrites the archive if it already exists for the day.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from datetime import date
+from pathlib import Path
+from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
+
+
+REPORTS_DIR = Path("/workspace/reports")
+ARCHIVES_DIR = Path("/workspace/archives")
+
+
+def build_archive_name(today: date) -> Path:
+    return ARCHIVES_DIR / f"reports_{today.isoformat()}.zip"
+
+
+def collect_txt_files(directory: Path) -> list[Path]:
+    return [p for p in directory.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix == ".txt"]
+
+
+def create_archive(src_dir: Path, dst_zip: Path) -> None:
+    dst_zip.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    files = collect_txt_files(src_dir)
+

+    with ZipFile(dst_zip, mode="w", compression=ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
+        for f in files:
+            zf.write(f, arcname=f.name)

+        print(f"Reports directory not found: {REPORTS_DIR}", file=sys.stderr)

+        print(f"Failed to create archive: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    print(str(archive_path))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
+
